node_definition.done_when: maps/ at the repository root is excluded by .gitignore, and imas_ambix/data/paths.py owns its path. maps/jt-60sa/ holds the flat bundle copied from /work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa/maps (bundle.json, machine_map.json, eddb_units.json, maps/magnetics.json, maps/pf_active.json, maps/tf.json, machine_description/OP1, machine_description/OP2), every file sha256-equal to its /work original, listed in a manifest log. Beside the bundle sit source/ and superseded/ copied from /work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa/machine_description, including superseded/differential-loops-staged/ byte for byte, also sha256-checked. git status shows nothing under maps/. packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/machine_map.py discover_bundles accepts an imas_alambic.bundles entry-point target that returns an iterable of MapBundle or bundle directories, alongside the single bundle or directory it accepts today, pinned by a test in packages/imas-alambic/tests/test_bundle_discovery.py; imas_ambix/data/bundle.py uses that to offer ambix own bundle plus every machine directory under maps/ that holds a bundle.json, so with IMAS_ALAMBIC_MAP_PATH unset imas-alambic config infers no machine but load_packaged_machine_map("jt-60sa") resolves to maps/jt-60sa/. JT60SA_DESCRIPTION_DIR and the census tests that read the description store resolve through the moved stores, and the census modules with IMAS_ALAMBIC_MAP_PATH unset add no failures against the base, judged by failure ids from one base run and one head run, each logged once. The repository AGENTS.md provisioning rule adds a maps symlink into each worktree beside .venv and .env, and a fresh worktree made by the rule carries it. Only after all of the above, /work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa/maps and /work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa/machine_description/source and /work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa/machine_description/superseded are listed with ls -laR to a log, removed, and shown gone; nothing else under /work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa changes (the EDDB zarr cache and ids/ stay). uv run --no-sync ruff check imas_ambix tests packages exits 0. All runs on the fleet allocation in place.
